The working tree HEAD is `e745e0e6ed` ("Experiment baseline", ~April 2023, post-MDX-v2-upgrade). ## 1. Primary md-vs-asset decision (most relevant to your bug)

**`packages/docusaurus-mdx-loader/src/remark/transformLinks/index.ts`**

- Function **`processLinkNode`** (lines 141–176). The key check is at **lines 161–167**:
  ```ts
  const hasSiteAlias = parsedUrl.pathname.startsWith('@site/');
  const hasAssetLikeExtension =
    path.extname(parsedUrl.pathname) &&
    !parsedUrl.pathname.match(/\.(?:mdx?|html)(?:#|$)/);
  if (!hasSiteAlias && !hasAssetLikeExtension) {
    return; // left as a normal markdown link
  }
  ```
  This is the exact spot where "contains `.md`" decides the link is a *markdown file link* rather than an asset. Important subtleties for your bug:
  - `path.extname('file.md__static_image_assets__')` returns `'.md__static_image_assets__'` (truthy), and the exclusion regex `/\.(?:mdx?|html)(?:#|$)/` does **not** match (the `.md` isn't followed by `#` or end-of-string), so the path is classified *asset-like*.

- Helper **`ensureAssetFileExist`** (lines 103–112).

## 2. Image handling (no `.md` exclusion at all)

**`packages/docusaurus-mdx-loader/src/remark/transformImage/index.ts`**

- **`processImageNode`** (lines 169–193): every `![...](...)` node with a non-protocol URL is unconditionally converted to a require-call.

**`packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts`**

- **`replaceMarkdownLinks`** (lines 54–231). The "is a markdown file link" test is the regex at **lines 120–121**:

    /(?:\]\(|\]:\s*)(?!https?:\/\/|@site\/)<?(?<filename>[^'"\]\s>]+(?:\s[^'"\]\s>]+)*\.mdx?)>?/g;

Done. The fix is in `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts` (the `replaceMarkdownLinks` used by linkify to rewrite `.md` file references).

**Root cause:** the old regex `(?:\]\(|\]:\s*)...[^...]+\.mdx?>?` was not anchored to the end of the URL, so a path like `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` matched `./file.md` mid-path and got corrupted into a doc permalink, breaking the image resolution.

**Fix:** replaced it with a rigorous Markdown link grammar — matching complete inline links (`[text](url "title")`, `<>`-wrapped URLs, stray spaces, `?query#hash` suffixes) and reference definitions, capturing the URL with the `d` regex flag for exact in-place splicing. A captured URL is only treated as a Markdown file reference if it itself ends with `.mdx?`, so `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` is left untouched.

- `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/__tests__/markdownLinks.test.ts`: 14/14 pass (the 2 previously failing FAIL_TO_PASS tests `does not replace non-Markdown links` and `handles stray spaces` now pass).
- `docusaurus-mdx-loader`, `plugin-content-docs` linkify, and all other `docusaurus-utils` suites pass; the only failures (globUtils, docs.test, index.test) fail identically on the untouched baseline, so they're pre-existing.
